items.item:
1. The owner opens a session while the agent replaces its request; granting
   with the old version is refused.
   Shows A12-1, A12-2. [witness: verification:registry_a12_grant_with_replaced_request_version_refused]
statements: owner_action(x, stated v) with v != version(x) => refused, x unchanged   -- A12-1
accepted change of x other than its end => version(x)' = version(x) + 1   -- A12-2

verdicts.why: The check verifies that replacing the request increments the version by exactly one, then that owner actions using the old version are refused as stale and leave the session and persisted row unchanged. It also controls that the accepted current-version grant changes the session and increments the version exactly once.
